integrity: Original mathematical references distinguished from new exact gap and scaling claims; verification is finite and not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Degree support only over integer coefficients; no assertion of unique polynomial divisor at a given degree; noncomplete regime p>2^a+1; Cantor limit fixes a,p. Earlier completeness criterion credited to Thompson. Publication priority remains subject to unindexed equivalent results; no independent audit.
title: Exact missing-degree gaps and Cantor limit for cyclotomic divisors with two-prime support
